source: Fleeting weekly discovery crawl whole-board history (board_source.py)
methodology: A window is a comeback only when the board history shows all four: it is on this week's board, it was absent from the immediately-preceding bundle, an earlier bundle carried a genuinely-passed close date (so it really closed - board absence alone is never read as a closure), and its current listing is forward-looking. We claim only that its last run ended on closed_on and it is back now. No guessed comebacks; a missing current end date is 'ongoing', not invented.

items.title: FirstBank Amphitheater Season Finale: Doobie Brothers & Five Finger Death Punch
items.blurb: The outdoor amphitheater closes out its season with a wild double-bill - the last chance to catch a show under the stars there until next year.

items.title: Soundcheck at Snitch: Weezer
items.blurb: A Weezer soundcheck experience at Snitch - the kind of intimate pre-show access that doesn't come around often.

items.title: Poolside Movie Night: Practical Magic
items.blurb: Outdoor poolside screening of Practical Magic at Drift Nashville. One night only; no ticket price stated.

items.title: Makers' Market
items.blurb: Outdoor makers and artisan market at Riverfront Park. One afternoon only; no entry fee stated.

items.title: Nashville Soccer Club vs. Sporting Kansas City
items.blurb: Nashville SC hosts Sporting Kansas City in a late-season MLS regular season match, with Pet Adoption Night presented by Mars Petcare running alongside the game at Geodis Park.

items.title: All'Antico Vinaio Apericena Experience
items.blurb: Italian apericena experience from the Florentine sandwich institution, from $90. Runs through mid-March.

items.title: Rocky Horror Picture Show with Live Shadow Cast
items.blurb: Screening with live performers acting out scenes in front of the screen, one night only. No ticket price stated.

items.title: Drug Store Coffee
items.blurb: Coffee concept operating inside Noelle hotel, open from 6 AM. Runs through Jan 1.

items.title: Common Ground: The Hainsworth Collection in Conversation with Cheekwood's Permanent Collection
items.blurb: Hainsworth Collection works installed alongside Cheekwood's permanent holdings in a paired exhibition format. Closes Nov 1. Ticketed.

items.title: Robert's Western World at Nissan Stadium
items.blurb: Broadway's most authentic honky-tonk is planting a flag at Nissan Stadium - first time the institution has expanded beyond its Lower Broadway home.

items.title: The Franklin Theatre Songwriters Series: Black River Entertainment Presents Doug Johnson, Josh Kerr, and Dan Wilson
items.blurb: In-the-round songwriters showcase presented by Black River Entertainment with three Nashville-connected writers. One night.

items.title: 6 Can't-Miss Spots for Nashville's 2026 Oktoberfest
items.blurb: Six Nashville spots are doing Oktoberfest right - steins, pretzels, and lederhosen energy while the season lasts.

items.title: Busiate Pasta Making Class + Lunch
items.blurb: Guests hand-roll busiate, the Sicilian spiral pasta shaped around a ferretto, inside Yolan's kitchen, then sit down to a three-course lunch of seasonal salad, busiate with pesto alla Trapanese, dessert, curated wine pairings, and fresh pasta to take home.

items.title: Fall Into Science
items.blurb: Temporary fall science programming at $10 to $50 depending on format, closing in three days. Specific exhibit content not described in the listing.
